name: Igrejinha (Brazil)
description: White field charged at the centre with the municipal arms with a church, a dove on blue and a scene of work on gold, over a scroll reading PAX ET LABOR IGREJINHA 1-6-1964.
history: Igrejinha is a municipality in the state of Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The flag was adopted on 1 December 1970 (prescribed by Municipal Law No. 161 of 1 December 1970, the arms by Law No. 43 of 1966, according to Flags of the World).
